card.name: Scattered words in general prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting. It fires on assorted common words (All, is, much, One, but, shade, term, for) in general encyclopedic or literary English prose.
card.plain: It reacts to scattered everyday words in ordinary prose, with no pattern a clinician could use.
